cases.description: Editor game-module rebuild/reload: the real Starforge editor scaffolds a real project (NewProjectAt) and drives BuildScripts -> BuildRunner (cmake configure+build) -> ReloadModule -> GameModule for 52 builds = 50 successful rebuild/reload cycles + 1 deliberate compile failure + 1 deliberate module-load failure, with 12 reflected-field changes (add/remove/rename/retype/default/component-type add+remove). After every reload: preserved values + new defaults resolve through reflection, descriptor field lists equal the variant exactly, probe UUID/Tag/Transform survive, Play stopped, selection+undo cleared, old DLL mapped while module-typed destructors ran and unmapped after, build stamp read back from the loaded DLL. The wrapper then parses the saved Main.cscene out of process against the expected table.
